findings.passage: “There needs to be a change in how quickly individuals can run out, get a weapon, and then return right back,” Del. Hayes said.
findings.note: Quoted by WTKR (News 3) a year after the Chesapeake Walmart shooting, on buying guns quickly. Date is the article's publish date.

findings.passage: “We have got to be courageous enough to do the things that are going to be necessary for us to bring about a change in this trajectory.”
findings.note: Quoted by WTKR (News 3) with the reporter's line that he has proposed a three day waiting period to buy a gun before and plans to introduce it again. Text on page reads: Hayes said that he vows to keep fighting for a change, adding the quote.

findings.passage: “None of this is anti-Second Amendment; it’s a common-sense legislation,” said Del. Cliff Hayes, D-Chesapeake, co-sponsor of House Bill 1644 , which requires reporting lost or stolen firearms.
findings.note: Quoted by Potomac Local at a press conference on gun safety proposals. URL date taken from the address; the outlet names him co-sponsor of HB1644 (reporting lost or stolen firearms). The LIS page lists a different patron, so co-sponsorship is the outlet's statement only.
